Objective: Ethan decides to attend Aurora's public appearance despite his anxiety, navigates the crowd dynamics of a superhero-dominated society, and positions himself in the venue without revealing his presence or intent.
IntendedChange: Ethan transitions from isolated avoidance to active participation in the public sphere, establishing his motivation (admiration/curiosity) and the immediate physical setting for the inciting incident.
ProhibitedPatterns: Do not have Ethan interact directly with Aurora or any other super.
Do not have Ethan's powers activate or cause any physical effect on another person.
Do not resolve the mystery of the bar incident.
Do not have Ethan leave the venue or change his mind about attending.

Scenes.Purpose: Ethan stands outside the venue, wrestling with the urge to leave, and decides to stay based on a mix of curiosity and a desire to see if the world is as safe as it claims to be.
Scenes.IntendedChange: Ethan commits to entering the venue, moving from passive avoidance to active participation.

Scenes.Purpose: Ethan navigates the security checkpoints and crowd control barriers, observing the casual normalization of super-powered security and the hierarchy of access.
Scenes.IntendedChange: Ethan enters the main viewing area, establishing his physical position relative to the stage and the flight path.

Scenes.Purpose: Ethan finds a spot in the crowd, experiencing sensory overload and the intense energy of the fans, while observing the distant figure of Aurora on the stage.
Scenes.IntendedChange: Ethan settles into his position, feeling a mix of awe and anxiety, and becomes fully present in the environment where the incident will occur.
